payload.title: Ideas flow again: conversation and acceptance context packs, signal-ranked single-item ideas
payload.description:
Slice 1 of PPY-2e9064. Make monitor-stories file theme ideas from recent human activity, using only data that exists today, and choose single-item ideas by signals instead of "every accepted, monitored, undrafted Reference".

Why: the 2026-11-01 run filed 0 ideas on all seven sites. collect_monitored_items (src/papyrus_content/ideas/monitor_stories.py) only takes accepted + monitor-delivered + undrafted References; Anth.us used its backlog on 10-29/30, new monitor arrivals stay pending (auto-accept Wilson bound 78.5% < 0.9), and hand-added/email/imported References have no discoveredByMonitorId. Nothing reads Messages, votes, concepts or edges.

Ryan's decisions (2026-11-01) that bind this slice: pending References may appear in packs as "not yet accepted" context, never as cited evidence; single-item ideas keep running beside packs but are chosen by signals; both kinds are balanced by the same signal score, not a fixed split.

Deploy: Papyrus release + one papyrus-monitoring change set (Ryan executes). No site deploy, no schema change.

Done when: every sub-task is closed; on Anth.us a dry run shows at least one pack; a real run files ideas that each cite at least two References and pass the Humanus gate; the router log line names each pack's statistic.
Design: the design comment on the epic PPY-2e9064 (copied to docs/idea-context-packs.md by S1.0).
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
